# Signhify

> AI-powered product studio. Describe your idea — we design, engineer, automate and launch it end-to-end.

## About

Signhify is an AI-first product studio founded by Piyush Raj Singh. We are a registered MSME (Govt. of India). We ship SaaS platforms, AI agents, CRMs, landing pages, and growth systems for ambitious founders and enterprises. We are building a broader AI product ecosystem (Studio → AI → Deploy → Marketplace → Cloud → OS) scaling to 100K+ live apps.

**Website**: https://signhify.dpdns.org
**Contact**: Piyushrajsingh092@gmail.com
**Founder**: Piyush Raj Singh
**GitHub**: https://github.com/Warriorlegacy

## Core Products & Services

### Signhify AI Blueprint Generator
- URL: https://signhify.dpdns.org/ai
- Describe your product idea in plain English. Six AI agents generate a full execution plan: schema design, design tokens, code generation, test suites, and deployment setup.
- Free to use. No sign-up required for basic prompts.

### Signhify Marketplace
- URL: https://signhify.dpdns.org/marketplace
- Production-ready templates, AI agent workflows, component kits, and SaaS starters.
- Creators can list and sell templates via Stripe checkout integration.

### Signhify Cloud & Deployment
- URL: https://signhify.dpdns.org/os
- Zero-config deployment: Cloudflare Workers/Pages hosting, GitHub integration, automated DNS, secrets vault.
- One-click deploy from AI-generated code to live production.

### Custom Development Services
- URL: https://signhify.dpdns.org/services
- AI Automation, SaaS Development, Web Applications, CRM Systems, Digital & Performance Marketing, Brand Strategy.
- Pricing: Sprint ($299), Studio ($799+), Platform (custom)

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: TanStack Start, React 19, Vite, TailwindCSS 4, Framer Motion, Three.js
- **Backend**: TanStack Server Functions, Node.js, Nitro
- **Database & Auth**: Supabase (PostgreSQL, RLS, OAuth via Google/GitHub)
- **AI**: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4o, Custom AI Gateway
- **Infrastructure**: Cloudflare Workers/Pages, GitHub Actions
- **Payments**: Stripe (checkout, subscriptions, credit packs)

## FAQ

**Q: What is Signhify?**
A: Signhify is an AI-powered product studio that turns ideas into production-ready software. Describe what you want in plain English, and our AI agent swarm designs, codes, tests, and deploys it.

**Q: How much does Signhify cost?**
A: Sprint plans start at $299 for rapid prototypes. Studio engagements start at $799 for full product builds. The AI Blueprint Generator is free to use.

**Q: Who founded Signhify?**
A: Signhify was founded by Piyush Raj Singh, an AI engineer and product builder based in India.

**Q: What technologies does Signhify use?**
A: React 19, TanStack Start, Supabase, Cloudflare, Stripe, and multiple AI models including Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o.

**Q: Can I sell templates on Signhify?**
A: Yes. The Signhify Marketplace allows independent builders and creators to list and sell templates, components, and AI agent workflows.
